messages:
anya: starting a tiny phased rollout for redwood/v3.1-int4 using a session-reservoir pattern. initial cap 1% sessions, target 8% over 3h. primary watch: p95 latency, rerank concordance, API error rate.
vikram: sounds good. propose gating rules: min_sample=600 overall, per-slice min_sample=300, concordance >= 0.925 required to step.
sam: question: how will reservoir handle multi-tab long sessions? we saw leakage last time.
anya: reservoir is session-lease based. each session gets a lease token; long-lived sessions count once until lease ttl expires. that prevents a single user from skewing samples.
infra-bot: deploy started: canary id c-17; image sha=9d3c2f; rollout config applied.
anya: pushed rollout config: 
```
model: redwood/v3.1-int4
initial_percent: 1
max_percent: 8
ramp_hours: 3
reservoir_mode: session_lease
lease_ttl_minutes: 20
min_total_sample: 600
min_slice_sample: 300
longdoc_min_sample: 900
concordance_threshold: 0.925
p95_latency_halt_pct: 25
error_rate_halt_pct: 0.5
hysteresis_windows: 2
escape_target: redwood/v3.0
auto_decrease_factor: 0.5
refill_backoff: 0.5
```
lina: add auto-escape: if p95 latency >25% OR concordance down >3pp OR error_rate +0.5% for 2 consecutive windows -> immediate rollback to escape_target. include 2-window re-entry hysteresis and mark a manual review if rollback happens.
vikram: also enforce a per-tenant throttling policy on escape: throttle to 5r/m for tenants impacted and shrink reservoir by 75% to limit blast radius.
sam: for longdoc slice require concordance >=0.94 and min_sample=900 before any ramp beyond 2%. long prompts have low-signal variance.
anya: noted, longdoc override added. plan: mid-roll audit at t+90m using "user-feedback-A" prompt set and rerank offline checks.
ops: pagerduty rule created: canary-v3.1-int4. will fire on p95 threshold and concordance delta. dashboards linked in the alert.
infra-bot: smoke checks: kv-cache warmup=82% at t+3m (non-blocking), rerank sanity OK.
lina: reminder: gate must block at 5% if offline recall test fails. last time that caught a recall drop.
anya: auto-decrease behavior: on any failed window reduce allocation by 50% and re-evaluate after 30m; on 3 consecutive fails mark rollout halted and require manual revert. refill backoff multiplier applied per fail.
vikram: +1. also log every lease-grant event to canary audit stream so we can compute unique-session sample counts.
sam: OK from my side, proceeding to start ramp. :rocket:
